hero.title: Sri Gupta: The Dynasty Founder
hero.description: Sri Gupta laid the foundational stone of the Gupta Empire, transitioning India from the post-Mauryan fragmentation toward the classical Golden Age.

timeline.title: The Chronological Framework
timeline.description: The rise of the Guptas occurred in the vacuum left by the declining Kushanas.

cards.details: Sri Gupta rules as a local chieftain, likely a feudatory of the Later Kushanas in the Magadha region.

items.title: S-G-C (Small Gupta Chain)
items.decryption: Remember the sequence of the first three rulers to avoid confusion between Sri Gupta and Chandragupta.

items: Do not confuse Sri Gupta with Chandragupta Maurya; they belong to completely different eras.
Sri Gupta was a 'Maharaja', not a 'Maharajadhiraja'. This title confirms his status as a subordinate ruler/feudatory.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Core: Magadha (Modern Bihar)
  • Expansion: Limited to Bengal/Bihar border

Personalities

  • Sri Gupta: Founder
  • I-Tsing: Chinese traveler who documented Sri Gupta

Core Historical Analysis

  • Epigraphic Evidence: Mentioned in the Poona Copper Plate of Prabhavatigupta.
  • Travelogue Account: The Chinese traveler I-Tsing (7th Century CE) refers to 'Che-li-ki-to' (Sri-Gupta) who built a temple for Chinese pilgrims near Mrigasikhavana.
  • Political Status: Feudatory nature proven by the title 'Maharaja'.
SourceDescription
I-TsingMentions 'Che-li-ki-to' as the founder
PrabhavatiguptaMentions Sri Gupta as the first ancestor
